definition: the state of being swollen.
example: ಕಾಲಿನ ಉರ್ಬು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಲು ಒಂದು ವಾರ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It took a week for the swelling in the leg to reduce.

definition: a lamp on high post or kept at a height.
example_en: A lamp on a high post was shining.

definition: a man who is humble, modest, unassuming.
example_en: He behaved humbly with everyone.

definition: to flow out.
example_en: Water flowed out from the broken vessel.

definition: going to a forbidden place; a moral or legal trespass.
example_en: That act was regarded as a forbidden trespass.

definition: a man who is experienced in the art of government or versed in the administration of government affairs or who exhibits great wisdom and ability in directing the affairs of a government or in dealing with important public issues; a statesman.
example_en: The statesman solved the state's problems with great skill.

definition: not ready.
example_en: The preparation needed for the feast was still not ready.

definition: to put, push, throw out.
example_en: The watchman threw the drunkard out.

definition: a person or animal that eats (something); an eater.
example_en: The hungry eater finished everything.

definition: greatness; eminence; superiority; distinction.
example_en: The king's eminence was renowned throughout the kingdom.

definition: a sound imitating the one made by a deflated balloon, etc.
example: ಬಲೂನು ಟುಸ್ ಎಂದು ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡುತ್ತ ಸೊರಗಿತು.
example_en: The balloon deflated making a fizzling sound.

definition: a pond or lake.
example_en: The children were playing on the bank of the pond.

definition: a time of great danger or trouble; crisis.
example_en: The country fell into an economic crisis.

definition: the common langur, Presbytis entellus.
example: ಕೋಡಗ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The langur sat on the tree branch and ate leaves.

definition: an infant; a baby; a child.
example_en: The baby was lying in the cradle, smiling.

definition: a peon orderly or office assistant.
example_en: The peon was waiting near the door.

definition: the quality or condition of being silent; absence of sound; silence; quietness.
example_en: The silence of the forest gave peace to the mind.

definition: the act of offering the life of a person or animal or some object, in propitiation of or homage to a deity; a sacrifice.
example_en: On the festival day, they offered a sacrifice to the goddess.

definition: work done or made by hand, not by machine; a hand-work.
example_en: This basket is the result of grandfather's handwork.

definition: a sect in Vīraśaiva religion.
example_en: That preceptor was a follower of the Aradhya sect.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: The nursing infant was sleeping in its mother's lap.

definition: a container, case or receptacle, usu. rectangular, of wood, metal, etc., and often with a hinged lid or removable cover; a box.
example_en: The jewellery had been kept in a wooden box.

definition: the hiccup one gets at the time of death.
example_en: The old man got the death hiccup and his life left him.

definition: a man having keen sight or he who is very good in aiming (the target).
example: ಆ ಬಿಲ್ಲುಗಾರ ದೃಷ್ಟಿವಾಳ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised that archer as one having keen aim.

definition: (dial.) a pledging of an agricultural land for the repayment of a loan authorising pledgee to enjoy the produce for a pre-determined period of time.
example: ರೈತನು ತನ್ನ ಗದ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಇಳಿವತ್ತೆಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಿಸಿ ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer pledged his paddy field for a fixed period and cleared his loan.

definition: a professional wrestler.
example: ಆ ಅಂಕಂಗಾರ ಕುಸ್ತಿ ಕಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಸೋಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That professional wrestler defeated everyone in the wrestling arena.

definition: the hard, stony skeleton secreted by certain marine polyps (class Anthozoa) and often deposited in extensive masses forming reefs and atolls in tropical seas; coral.
example_en: Red coral had been set into her bangles.

definition: a thick club; a cudgel.
example_en: The guard stood holding a thick club.

definition: a fragment or piece taken out from a whole.
example_en: The torn piece of paper flew away in the wind.

definition: a kind of cotton plant.
example_en: The huccuhatti cotton plant grows in that region.

definition: much hotness; great warmth; hot weather or climate.
example_en: The people were exhausted by the summer's great heat.

definition: a building or residence for Buddhist monks.
example_en: The monks live in the Buddhist monastery.

definition: the small plant Rauwolfia serpentina of Apocynaceae family, that grows to a height of 20 to 30 cms., the roots of which yields the alkaloid reserpine.
example_en: Medicine is prepared from the root of the hadaki plant.

definition: (said of a woman) a marrying to a man who is already married once (either with the first wife being alive or dead).
example: ಅವಳ ಇಮ್ಮನೆ ಮದುವೆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸುದ್ದಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Her second marriage became big news in the town.

definition: the quality, tendency of a person who makes mischiefs; mischievousness.
example_en: His mischievousness was known to the whole village.

definition: a hurrying or being hurried; rush; urgency; hurry.
example: ಬಸ್ಸು ತಪ್ಪಿಹೋಗುವ ಭಯದಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಲಗುಬಗೆ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He was overcome with hurry from the fear of missing the bus.

definition: a punishment awarded or to be awarded for a crime, offence.
example_en: The judge awarded punishment to the offender.

definition: (pl) two sides (of a thing, person etc.).
example_en: There are shops on both sides of the road.

definition: Bhřngi, a three-legged attendent of Śiva.
example_en: Bhringi stood in the presence of Shiva.

definition: a secluded place.
example_en: He meditated in a secluded place in the forest.

definition: a kind of plant .
example_en: They identified the cavuḍangi plant in the forest.

definition: the act of colliding or coming together with sudden, violent force; a collision.
example_en: In the collision of the two vehicles, two people were injured.

definition: the quality of being very delicious.
example_en: Everyone liked the intense deliciousness of this sweet.

definition: the act or fact of coming into life or of being born; birth.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಪುಟ್ಟು ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The child's birth brought joy to the whole family.

definition: an unhewn piece of a felled tree or a similar rough mass of wood.
example: ಅವನು ಕೊಱಡನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಬಂಡಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: He lifted the rough log and threw it onto the cart.

definition: a folk goddess.
example_en: The villagers worship the folk goddess Hulagemma.

definition: to lose the order, sequence.
example_en: The sequence of the programme lost its order.

definition: a wall surrounding something; an enclosure.
example_en: A surrounding wall was built around the village.

definition: a stretched arm.
example_en: He stretched out his arm and plucked the fruit.

definition: a relinquishing, abandoning or being relinquished, abandoned; relinquishment; abandonment.
example: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಆಸ್ತಿಯ ವಿವರ್ಜಿತ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ನೋವು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The relinquishment of all his property caused him great pain.

definition: much hotness; great warmth; heat.
example_en: In summer, the heat was unbearably great.

definition: a worker in a skilled trade; an artisan or artist.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರಗೆಲಸಿ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಗೋಡೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಕೆತ್ತನೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That artisan carved beautiful designs on the temple walls.

definition: arrogance; conceit; disdain; contempt.
example_en: His arrogance annoyed everyone.

definition: to become equal (to another).
example_en: His strength was such that it could equal an elephant's.

definition: sodium borate, a white, anhydrous, crystalline salt, Na2B4O7, with an alkaline taste, used as a flux in soldering metals and in the manufacture of glass, enamel, artificial gems, soaps, antiseptics, etc.; borax.
example: ಬೆಳಗಾರವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಅವನು ಲೋಹವನ್ನು ಬೆಸುಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: He used borax and soldered the metal.

definition: to make a promise; to promise.
example_en: He made a promise that he would come.

definition: (a green or greenish-blue coating) to form on the surface of brass, bronze or copper utensils.
example_en: Verdigris formed on the old copper vessel.

definition: a kind of herb.
example_en: The chikkakalluri herb was found among the rocks.

definition: (a flower-bud) to expand, blow up; to blossom.
example_en: In the garden the rose bud blossomed open.

definition: any of the two receptacles in a weighing scale; a pan.
example_en: The trader weighed the rice in the pan of the scale.

definition: to force (an object, esp. a long or thin one) from a straight form into a curved or angular one; to bend.
example_en: He forcefully bent the iron rod.

definition: a weak, feeble man.
example: ಆ ನಿರ್ಬಲ ರೋಗದಿಂದ ಎದ್ದು ನಿಲ್ಲಲಾರದೆ ಇದ್ದನು.
example_en: That feeble man was unable to get up because of the illness.

definition: to be restrained, controlled or subjugated.
example_en: His anger was finally getting restrained.

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example_en: The children were playing under the tamarind tree.

definition: any of a class of chemical elements, as iron, gold or aluminum, generally characterised by ductility, malleability, luster, and conductivity of heat and electricity; a metal.
example_en: Metal is found in that mine.

definition: the space, amount or degree to which a thing extends; extent.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ಪರ್ವುಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹರಡಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಅಳೆದರು.
example_en: They measured how far the extent of the forest had spread.

definition: a man whose work is dressing hair, shaving and trimming beards etc.; a barber.
example_en: The barber cut hair in the shop.

definition: the bony framework of the human head; skull.
example_en: The zoologists examined that skull.

definition: an inner jacket.
example_en: She wore an inner jacket under the saree.

definition: a house made using plant materials (as leaves, twigs, straw, etc ) as of a hermit in a forest.
example_en: The ascetic lived in a hut made of leaves.

definition: a kind of bird believed to indicate the future events; a bird of omen.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಉಳಿಗ ಹಕ್ಕಿಯ ಕೂಗನ್ನು ಶಕುನವೆಂದು ನಂಬಿದರು.
example_en: The village people believed the call of the bird of omen to be a sign.

definition: wholly; completely; in all; totally.
example_en: He finished the work completely.

definition: the upper garment of woman, covering the shoulders, back and breasts; a blouse.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಱವಕೆಯನ್ನು ಜೋಪಾನ ಮಾಡಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother had carefully kept her old blouse.

definition: to cause to laugh.
example_en: His joke made everyone laugh.

definition: a fraudulent activity; the business of cheating others.
example_en: That company was carrying on a fraudulent business with customers.

definition: to go over or look through for the purpose of finding something; to explore; to search.
example_en: The police searched the entire area for the thieves.

definition: the state of being at the lowest point.
example_en: Everyone in society knew about his lowest status.

definition: a general name designating several trailing annual vines of cucumber family.
example_en: The farmer planted a cucumber-family vine in the field.

definition: to attract; to be attractive, fascinating; to be ostentatious.
example_en: The gem sparkled attractively in the light.

definition: to make a continuous gentle, gleeful sound, as in mild amusement; to chuckle.
example_en: The baby chuckled seeing its mother.

definition: good fortune; prosperity; welfare.
example_en: His life was full of prosperity.

definition: the condition of being full; fullness.
example_en: Seeing the fullness of the pond, the children were delighted.

definition: a house where prostitution is carried on.
example_en: There was a brothel house at the corner of that street.

definition: the plant Ochna beddomei of Ochnaceae family.
example_en: A ಪಾಳೆಗೊರವಿ plant has grown in the forest.

definition: good looking; beautiful.
example_en: That girl is truly good looking.

definition: a false show; pretension; simulation; feigning.
example: ಅವನ ಕಣ್ಣೀರು ಬರೀ ಒಣಸೋಗು ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone knew that his tears were just a false show.

definition: to feel ashamed; to be ashamed or embarrassed.
example: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದ ಹುಡುಗ ಗುರುಗಳ ಮುಂದೆ ಎಗ್ಗಱಿದನು.
example_en: The boy who made the mistake felt ashamed before the teacher.

definition: harsh; unkind; merciless.
example: ಆ ಯಜಮಾನ ತನ್ನ ಆಳುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬೆರಟೆಯಾಗಿ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದ.
example_en: That master behaved harshly and mercilessly towards his servants.

definition: the science of numbers; arithmetic.
example_en: In olden times traders used arithmetic.

definition: to add up, one by one, by units or groups, so as to get a total; to count.
example_en: The clerk carefully counted the total money.

definition: live spark.
example_en: A live spark flew from the hearth and caught the cloth.

definition: a structure of railings held up by small posts, as on a staircase; a balustrade.
example_en: They fitted a balustrade to the house's staircase.

definition: (used in praising a performer) well done! very good! excellent!.
example_en: The audience shouted 'well done!' to the singer.

definition: to be or become firm or stable; to be fixed.
example_en: After the rain the mud wall became firm.

definition: a slapping on another's face with ones open palm.
example_en: In anger, he gave his son a slap on the face.

definition: the act or practice of deceiving by pretending to be kind, virtuous, pious, etc.
example_en: Everyone has now found out about his hypocritical pretence.

definition: that is fit to be or capable of being, spread.
example_en: This oil was fit to spread over the whole cloth.

definition: to shake; to give a shake to; to cause to move.
example_en: The wind shook the branches of the tree.

definition: to put down; to reduce in height, elevation, amount, price etc.
example_en: The heat made the leaves of the tree droop down.

definition: the outer cloth, fittings and material used in upholstering a tent.
example_en: They brought the tent's outer cloth and fittings from the shop.

definition: the son of a king; a prince.
example_en: That prince showed valor in the battle.

definition: to remove the dining plates (after dinner, for cleaning).
example_en: After the meal was over, mother removed the dining plates.

definition: brightness; brilliance; splendour.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಎಸಕ ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The brilliance of the morning sun lit up the whole town.

definition: a shivering, trembling.
example_en: A shivering came over his body due to the cold.

definition: the simultaneous sale of security or commodity in different markets to profit from unequal prices; an arbitrage.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಪೇಟೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತರಪಣನ ಮಾಡಿ ಲಾಭ ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The trader made an arbitrage in different markets and earned a profit.

definition: love; affection; fondness.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಗೆಳೆಯರ ನಡುವಿನ ನಲ್ಕೆ ಬಹಳ ಆಳವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The affection between the two friends was very deep.

definition: a case containing the charge for a gun; a cartridge.
example_en: There was a cartridge case in the soldier's bag.

definition: rapidity in moving, going, traveling, proceeding or performing; swiftness; speed.
example_en: The horse won the race with its speed.

definition: pleasure derived from luxury articles.
example_en: A life of luxurious pleasure was going on in the palace.

definition: to refuse; to say 'no'.
example_en: She refused that proposal and left.

definition: that includes everything; all-inclusive.
example_en: This project brings an all-inclusive change.

definition: the place of where stays for a temporary period.
example_en: The soldiers stayed a week at the temporary halting place.

definition: a man carrying a burden.
example: ಹೊಱೆಗಾಱ ಗುಡ್ಡದ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರೆ ಹೊತ್ತು ಸಾಗಿದನು.
example_en: The burden-carrier went along the hill path carrying the load.

definition: a living being not qualified to be emancipated from the cycle of birth and death.
example_en: People say he is a being unfit for liberation.

definition: to irritate or provoke with persistent petty distractions, playful fooling, trifling raillery or other annoyance; to annoy; to tease.
example_en: The brother teased his sister playfully during the game and made her laugh.

definition: a man who has just married or is about to marry; a bride-groom.
example: ಆ ಮದೆವ ಹೊಸ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ತೊಟ್ಟು ಸಿಂಗರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The bridegroom dressed in new clothes and adorned himself.

definition: an establisher, founder, creator, bearer or supporter.
example_en: Brahma is called the creator of the universe.

definition: prohibited; tabooed; forbidden.
example_en: That book was prohibited in the school.

definition: pure cereal of Cajanus indicus; red gram.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಚ್ಚದೊಗರಿ ಸಿಗದೆ ಬೇರೆ ಕಡೆ ಹೋದೆ.
example_en: Since pure red gram was not available in the shop, I went elsewhere.

definition: to fall upon; to assault; to attack.
example_en: The dog suddenly started to attack him.

definition: the diphthong ai; or its sound.
example_en: When pronouncing the diphthong ai, the mouth opens wide.

definition: riches; wealth.
example: ಆ ಮನೆತನದ ಬಳಿ ಅಪಾರ ಸಿರಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That family possessed immense wealth.

definition: a confining or being confined under watchful custody.
example_en: The police kept him under watchful custody.

definition: the relation of a man and a woman married to each other, at least for one of whom this is a remarrige.
example_en: The whole family agreed to their remarriage relationship.

definition: a variety of sugarcane.
example_en: Farmers grow the kanigila variety of sugarcane in large quantities.

definition: the condition of things being strewn in a loose and disorderly manner.
example_en: If you leave the clothes strewn about in disorder, the house becomes messy.

definition: the eastern ocean.
example_en: The sun rose from the eastern ocean.

definition: the performance of duties or the duties performed as or by a waiter or servant.
example_en: The servant was performing his duties as a waiter to his master.

definition: an idiotic, brainless woman.
example: ಆ ಹೆಡ್ಡಿ ಯಾರ ಮಾತನ್ನೂ ಕೇಳದೆ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That foolish woman acted without listening to anyone.

definition: the faculty, power or act of speaking; speech.
example_en: His speech won everyone's heart.

definition: pasta made of wheat flour in the form of long, thin strings, cooked by boiling or steaming and served with a sauce; spaghetti.
example_en: We bought a packet of thin spaghetti from the shop.

definition: a woman acting with an evil intent; a wicked woman.
example: ಆ ತುಂಡಿ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕೇಡು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That wicked woman wished ill on everyone in the house.

definition: to say 'no'.
example_en: He said no to what she asked.

definition: the watery discharge from the mucous membranes of the eyes; the rheum of the eye.
example_en: Rheum was oozing from the eye.

definition: a property of certain fundamental particles of all matter, as electrons (negative charges) and protons or positrons (positive charges) that have a force field associated with them and that can be separated by the expenditure of energy: electricity.
example_en: The house went dark without electricity.

definition: the wide mouth of a river, where the salty tide meets the freshwater current of the river; river mouth; firth; estuary.
example_en: The fishermen cast their nets at the river's estuary.

definition: a harmonious living together (of husband and wife).
example_en: There should be harmonious living between husband and wife.

definition: the quality of a wicked person; wickedness.
example_en: His wickedness had become known to the whole village.

definition: constituting an alternative; alernate.
example_en: He reached the town by an alternate route.

definition: a badge of honour bestowed on a hero, worn as a garter on the leg.
example_en: They honoured the hero by tying the badge of honour on his leg.

definition: the act or an instance of recurring; reoccurrence; recurrence.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯ ಪೌನಃಪುನ್ಯ ಜನರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಯ ಮೂಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The recurrence of that incident created fear among the people.

definition: the hollow stalk of some plants as lotus.
example_en: He cut and brought the hollow stalk of the lotus.

definition: the cardinal number sixteen.
example: ಆ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಸೋಳಹ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅವನು ಎಣಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He counted the sixteen number of those items.

definition: an unsuitable, unfriendly woman.
example_en: Being an unsuitable, unfriendly woman, she troubled everyone.

definition: (fig.) a person of long experience in some occupation or position; a veteran.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಹುಲಿ ಈ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಲವತ್ತು ವರ್ಷ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That veteran has worked in this field for forty years.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: She wrapped the infant in a cloth.

definition: a soluting formally.
example_en: The servant formally saluted the king.

definition: a water jar.
example_en: She brought water in a golden water jar.

definition: the pair of thighs in humans.
example_en: His pair of thighs became strong through exercise.

definition: a small drum, a percussion instrument.
example_en: They were playing the small drum at the festival.

definition: to pass a comb through the hair to arrange or clean it; to comb.
example_en: She combs her hair every morning.

definition: any oil having bad smell; a rancid oil.
example_en: The smell of this rancid oil is very bad.

definition: anything that is clean.
example_en: That cloth looked completely clean.

definition: to be subject to or determined by another.
example_en: His success depends on his hard work.

definition: a place where converging sides or edges meet; the internal space or recess formed by the meeting of two walls, esp. of a room; a corner.
example_en: The children had kept the toys in the corner.

definition: the ministerial cabinet of the government of a state.
example_en: The cabinet approved a new scheme today.

definition: an act, action, process; a thing to be done.
example_en: There is much work to be done tomorrow.

definition: a man of wicked devices; a man who works with evil intent; a machinator.
example_en: The machinator deceived everyone with his wicked scheme.

definition: a solemn promise or pledge, esp. one made to a god, dedicating oneself to an act, service or way of life; a vow.
example_en: He made a vow to God.

definition: to wander in search of; to search for something.
example_en: He wandered through the forest searching for the lost sheep.

definition: light of a burning piece of wood (as the one got in places where no other means of light is available, as in a forest, remote place, etc.).
example_en: In the forest they found the way by the light of a burning piece of wood.

definition: the region consisting of coastal districts of Western Karnāṭaka.

definition: to open one's eyes; to see.

definition: a man addicted or being enslaved to a habit or practice obsessively; an addict.

example_en: The fishermen rubbed raw salt on the fish and dried it in the sun.

definition: special or deep knowledge.
example_en: That scholar had deep knowledge of the scripture.

definition: historical - a) of, pertaining to, treating or characteristic of history or past events; b) providing evidence for a fact of history; serving as a source of history; c) fit to be considered as a memorable event in the history.
example_en: This is a historical event.

definition: to laugh in a half-suppressed way, suggestive of silliness, nervousness, etc.; to giggle; to titter.
example_en: The girl covered her face and ran away giggling.

definition: the fringe of hair edging the eyelid.
example_en: Her row of eyelashes enhanced the beauty of her eyes.

definition: to cause to fill the entire area or to become spread over a wide area.
example_en: The rainwater spread across the entire field.

definition: to cause to jump or spring up (into the air suddenly, leaving the ground or other support).
example_en: The child made the ball spring up into the air.

definition: the fore or ventral part of the body between the neck and the abdomen; the chest; the breast; the bosom.
example_en: The arrow pierced his chest.

definition: a look; a glance.
example_en: She cast a glance and moved on.

definition: he who is given to some strong, evil habit or habits.
example_en: The man addicted to the evil habit of drink ruined his own family.

definition: to cause to become blur, dull, not brilliant.
example_en: The dust made the mirror dull.
